criteria.title: Exact verse and edition
criteria.startingState: The pilot contains verified reference fixtures with edition-specific locators.
actions: Search a work alias with a verse reference.
criteria.expectedResult: The intended passage and edition resolve, or alternative edition matches are labeled separately.

criteria.title: Script and spelling variants
criteria.startingState: Reviewed Devanāgarī, IAST and plain Latin forms identify the same passage.
criteria.expectedResult: Each variant retrieves the expected passage and displays the source wording intact.

criteria.title: Search by meaning
criteria.startingState: Held-out questions name concepts or describe passages without copying their words.
criteria.expectedResult: Results meet the agreed passage recall target and cite the intended passages.

criteria.title: Inspect commentary and context
criteria.startingState: A fixture has a verified commentary alignment and neighboring passages.
actions: Open a verse from the results and inspect its commentary and context.
criteria.expectedResult: The result distinguishes complete source text, context, commentary author and edition, and the alignment evidence.

criteria.title: Insufficient evidence
criteria.startingState: The fixture set includes absent references and unanswerable queries.
actions: Search for an absent reference or a question outside corpus coverage.
criteria.expectedResult: The system reports insufficient evidence and supplies no fabricated citation.

criteria.title: Select retrieval from measured results
criteria.startingState: The pilot inputs, held-out queries, comparison metrics and selection rule are fixed.
actions: Compare lexical, semantic and hybrid variants on identical inputs.
criteria.expectedResult: The decision record reports quality and latency by query class and explains the chosen variant against the selection rule.
